title: Heat Distortion Around Fire Source Affecting Scenery
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN importmap for three, three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader, three/addons/loaders/DRACOLoader, three/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer, three/addons/postprocessing/RenderPass, three/addons/postprocessing/ShaderPass) that implements a heat distortion post-processing effect emanating from a fire source affecting surrounding scenery.

SCENE SETUP:
- Create a WebGLRenderer with antialias, size 1024x768, appended to document.body with margin 0 overflow hidden.
- Use a PerspectiveCamera(50, aspect, 0.1, 2000) positioned at (0, 8, 25) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (0xffffff, 0.4) and a directional light (0xffeedd, 1.0) at (10, 20, 10).
- Add a ground plane (PlaneGeometry 100x100, MeshStandardMaterial gray) rotated -PI/2 on X at y=0.
- Load 'BoxAnimated.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at position (0, 1.5, 0) with scale (2, 2, 2). Play its first AnimationClip via AnimationMixer. This box represents the FIRE SOURCE — add a PointLight(0xff4400, 3, 20) as a child at (0, 2, 0) to simulate fire glow. The point light intensity should pulse sinusoidally between 1.5 and 4.5 over time.
- Load 'LittlestTokyo.glb' using GLTFLoader (enable DRACOLoader with decoder path 'https://www.gstatic.com/draco/versioned/decoders/1.5.7/'). Scale it to (0.005, 0.005, 0.005) and position at (5, 0, -5). Play its first AnimationClip if available.

HEAT DISTORTION SHADER (Post-Processing):
- Implement a custom ShaderPass that creates a heat distortion effect.
- The vertex shader passes UV coordinates.
- The fragment shader receives uniforms: tDiffuse (scene texture), uTime (float), uDistortionStrength (float, default 0.015), uDistortionRadius (float, default 0.35), uHeatCenter (vec2, default (0.5, 0.55) in screen UV space), uEnabled (bool, default true), uFrequency (float, default 12.0), uFalloff (float, default 2.0).
- The distortion algorithm: compute distance from current UV to uHeatCenter. If distance < uDistortionRadius and uEnabled is true, compute a falloff factor = pow(1.0 - distance/uDistortionRadius, uFalloff). Apply sinusoidal displacement to UV: offset.x = sin(uv.y * uFrequency + uTime * 3.0) * uDistortionStrength * falloff; offset.y = cos(uv.x * uFrequency + uTime * 2.5) * uDistortionStrength * falloff * 0.7. Sample tDiffuse at uv + offset.
- Use EffectComposer with RenderPass then the custom ShaderPass.

INTERACTION & CONTROLS:
- Mouse move: track normalized mouse position. When Shift is held and mouse moves, update uHeatCenter to match mouse UV coords (mouseX/window.innerWidth, 1.0 - mouseY/window.innerHeight). Release Shift to stop updating.
- Keyboard 'E' or 'e': toggle uEnabled (on/off). When disabled, no distortion is applied.
- Keyboard 'ArrowUp': increase uDistortionStrength by 0.005, clamped to max 0.06.
- Keyboard 'ArrowDown': decrease uDistortionStrength by 0.005, clamped to min 0.0.
- Keyboard 'ArrowRight': increase uFrequency by 1.0, clamped to max 30.0.
- Keyboard 'ArrowLeft': decrease uFrequency by 1.0, clamped to min 1.0.
- Keyboard 'R' or 'r': reset all distortion parameters to defaults (strength 0.015, radius 0.35, center (0.5, 0.55), frequency 12.0, falloff 2.0, enabled true).
- Keyboard 'U' or 'u': UNDO last parameter change. Maintain a history stack (max 20 entries) of parameter snapshots. Each change pushes current state before modification.
- Keyboard 'Y' or 'y': REDO last undone change. Maintain a redo stack that is cleared on any new change.

HUD (DOM overlay):
- Create a fixed div top-left (id='hud') with semi-transparent dark background, white text, monospace font, padding 12px, z-index 100.
- Display: Distortion: ON/OFF, Strength: X.XXX, Frequency: XX.X, Center: (X.XX, X.XX), Radius: X.XX, History: N entries, Redo: N entries.
- Update HUD every frame.

STATE MANAGEMENT (window.__3D_STATE__):
Expose and update every frame:
- enabled: boolean, current uEnabled value
- strength: number, current uDistortionStrength
- frequency: number, current uFrequency
- radius: number, current uDistortionRadius
- falloff: number, current uFalloff
- heatCenter: {x: number, y: number}, current uHeatCenter
- fireLightIntensity: number, current PointLight intensity
- boxLoaded: boolean, true once BoxAnimated.glb loaded
- sceneryLoaded: boolean, true once LittlestTokyo.glb loaded
- boxPosition: {x, y, z}, world position of box
- sceneryPosition: {x, y, z}, world position of scenery
- boxAnimationPlaying: boolean
- sceneryAnimationPlaying: boolean
- historyLength: number, undo stack length
- redoLength: number, redo stack length
- frameCount: number, incremented each frame
- lastAction: string, name of last action performed (e.g. 'toggle_enabled', 'increase_strength', 'decrease_strength', 'increase_frequency', 'decrease_frequency', 'reset', 'undo', 'redo', 'move_center')
- composerActive: boolean, true if EffectComposer is rendering
- parameterSnapshot: {strength, frequency, radius, falloff, centerX, centerY, enabled}, current full snapshot
physics_constraints: Heat distortion strength must remain in [0.0, 0.06]. Frequency must remain in [1.0, 30.0]. Heat center UV coordinates must remain in [0.0, 1.0] range. Fire light intensity must oscillate sinusoidally between 1.5 and 4.5 (never NaN or negative). Undo/redo stacks must be consistent: undo restores exact previous state, redo restores exact forward state. Redo stack clears on any new user action. History stack max 20 entries (FIFO eviction of oldest).
